name: The Rev. Dr. Bob Ayres
title: Assisting Priest
shortBio: Founding pastor/priest of DeafChurch Together movement.
fullBio:
The Rev. Dr. Bob Ayres is the founding pastor/priest of DeafChurch Together movement. He has published two books on Deaf ministry including Deaf Diaspora: The Third Wave of Deaf Ministry and DEAFCHURCH 21: Vision for a New Generation. God stirred up a vision in Fr. Bob's heart for establishing a Deaf Liturgical Church movements based on the model of multiple home and community congregations a part of a regional parish connected by online weekly liturgical services in American Sign Language.

Fr. Bob and Deacon Kathy Ayres, have been involved in Deaf ministry since the middle 1980s and together in 2000, established Deaf Teen Quest (DTQ), which has been a national ministry model of Youth For Christ USA since 2009. The Ayres have six adult children who came to them through adoption (two of whom are Deaf) and a dozen delightful grandchildren!
